title: Paper Mono by Paper
note: Free, open-source monospace family by Paper (paper.design). Variable weight axis 100-800 (8 weights), 800 glyphs, 100+ languages. Flat terminals, gently squared curves and a balanced x-height give it the feel of a classic sans; made for headlines, text, UI and code. Stylistic sets: SS01 coding ligatures, SS02 duospace glyphs, SS03 narrow space, SS04 small arrows, CV01 single-story a, slashed zero. Site hero shows outlined glyphs on a metrics grid. Found via @praveenjuge's font list (Nov 27, 2026). Thumbnail is a screenshot of the site.
